meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能助手具备部署网站的能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望智能助手能自动把网站发布上线
copy.tagline_en: Enable your assistant to deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to deploy websites for you

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会负责把网页应用部署到 Vercel:使用 Vercel 命令行,并自动带上已配置的 Vercel 凭据;整个过程自己执行,只有缺少令牌时才向你要。
howto.when: 当用户让代理把网页应用部署到 Vercel 时触发;若 OneCLI 未安装,会先提示运行 /init-onecli。

say.text: 把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
列出我在 Vercel 上的所有部署。
say.note: Claude 会运行 vercel ls 查看列表。

say.text: 查一下 Vercel 的登录状态。
say.note: Claude 会运行 vercel whoami 验证凭据。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can deploy web apps to Vercel via the Vercel CLI, with credentials auto-injected by OneCLI. It does the setup itself and only asks for a token when one is missing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks agents to deploy web applications to Vercel. If OneCLI is missing, it prompts the user to run /init-onecli first.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production.
List all my deployments on Vercel.
say_en.note: Uses vercel ls to show them.
